title: Cosmic Wanderer
description: A young girl with short hair, multiple eyes on her face and head, wearing a decorated backpack walks away along a path lined with lavender flowers. To her right, a large surreal alien entity with many eyes, geometric patterns, and tentacles emerges from a purple glowing portal against a starry cosmic background with constellations and geometric mountains.
